description: Hi! I'm a student passionate about space exploration, astronomy, coding, AI, and game development. I enjoy creating interactive websites, games, and simulations while learning new technologies. I'm joining the NASA Space Apps Challenge to collaborate, explore creative ideas, and solve real-world problems. I'm looking for teammates skilled in programming, UI/UX design, astronomy, research, 3D modeling, and presentations. Let's work together to create something innovative and inspiring! 🚀🌌
